FIRST RUN, 2026-09-21: 66 routes probed, 84 overlay opens, 14 finding records,
9 distinct keys. Disposition of all 9:
6 x no-accessible-name — REAL, and FIXED rather than baselined. Five Radix
PopoverContents rendered role="dialog" with no name, so a screen reader
announced each as bare "dialog": ReviewsTab (sort), SavedHelpersTab
(filter, sort), JobActionRow (job overflow actions), RecognitionRow (the
+N-more badge list). ReviewsTab's OTHER popover already carried an
aria-label with a comment explaining exactly this, so the convention
existed and these five had simply missed it.
1 x background-not-scroll-locked — NOT a defect, a defect in the CHECK. It
keyed on role="dialog", which Radix also gives a non-modal Popover, and a
Popover is SUPPOSED to leave the page behind scrollable. The rule now keys
on aria-modal="true", which is both the right discriminator and the exact
property that makes the rule's rationale true.
2 x axe:color-contrast — REAL, and NOT ours to fix. Below.

keys./availability :: dialog :: axe:color-con: TimeRangeField popover, trigger "9 AM – 5 PM": #83837c on #ffffff = 3.81:1, needs 4.5:1 (WCAG 2 AA 1.4.3, axe impact serious). NOT a component bug — #83837c is --muted-foreground resolving through --stormy-sky in src/index.css, so EVERY text-muted-foreground on a white or card surface fails AA and this popover is just where the sweep can see it. src/index.css is orchestrator-owned; filed for the design/a11y lane rather than patched here.
keys./profile?tab=availability :: dialog :: a: The same TimeRangeField popover on the canonical Profile tab. /availability is a redirecting alias of this route (see redirectsTo in auditRoutes.ts), so these two keys are ONE defect seen twice — they are both listed because the ratchet is keyed by route and must stay mechanical.
